paragraphs: Quodus sells room-by-room people counting that measures how campus spaces are actually used, and the page states the count does not rely on personal Wi-Fi devices. The product connects to the institution's ERP and compares planned activity with what happened in the room. Results are presented in role-based dashboards aimed at different stakeholders.

The pages address higher education, naming the Provost's office, the Registrar, the CFO, Deans, Campus & Space Planning and Facilities management as the readers of the data. Named institutions on the site include West University of Timisoara, Loyola University and Universidad de Navarra.

One testimonial describes a space optimization project covering over 430 spaces, deployed in two weeks with night shifts during the academic year. Another describes the project as now implemented across all academic spaces and libraries.

quote.text: Like an X-ray for your campus, we look beneath the surface of the schedule to diagnose hidden inefficiencies
